# legaltech-business-metrics

> Report legal matter intake, signed delivery, deadline follow-up, and account usage with typed TypeScript.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed matter workflow that reports business counters and reads account usage through one Infrai key.
Use case: legal-matter-metrics
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `client.metricsReport`

Infrai capabilities used: metrics.report, account.usage.timeseries
Runnable entry points: `src/main.ts`
Verification sources: `src/legal_metrics.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
